name: Judgement Day
detailed_description:
Detective Roger Morgan, renowned for his sharp mind and unyielding dedication, finds himself in an unimaginable nightmare. Trapped in the house of his closest friend and partner, Jack Clark, Roger must navigate a series of twisted, cryptic challenges set by an unseen tormentor. With each puzzle solved, dark secrets from the past emerge, forcing Roger to confront the hidden truths that tie him to Jack. As the house becomes a living labyrinth of terror, Roger's sanity is tested, and the lines between ally and enemy blur. In this psychological horror, the real question is: who is truly being judged?

Play as Detective Roger Morgan

Roger’s goal is to escape the house while uncovering the mystery behind his entrapment. But as he progresses, he’s forced to confront his own past and the horrifying truth behind his relationship with Jack Clark. Every choice he makes could either bring him closer to the truth—or push him further into the unknown.

A Home Turned Nightmare

Surviving Jack Clark’s house requires more than courage—it demands intelligence, perception, and control over reality. Solve puzzles, crack safes, and decrypt messages while exploring unsettling rooms. The house shifts, whispers, and distorts, reacting to Roger’s actions and testing his sanity. Every choice affects his fate, leading to multiple endings. With limited resources, eerie sounds, and unseen threats, can you escape with your mind intact?

The Mind is Your Only Weapon

Surviving Jack Clark’s house demands more than courage—it requires intelligence, perception, and control over reality. Solve intricate puzzles, crack safes, and decrypt hidden messages while uncovering unsettling clues. The house shifts, whispers, and distorts, reacting to Roger’s every move and testing his sanity. Every choice shapes his fate, leading to multiple endings. With limited resources, eerie sounds, and unseen threats, can you escape with your mind intact?

short_description: Judgment Day is a psychological horror puzzle-adventure game. Detective Roger Morgan is trapped in a twisted version of his partner Jack Clark’s home. Each puzzle he solves unravels dark secrets, distorting reality and blurring the line between friend and foe, forcing him to question everything.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel CPU Core i5-2500K 3.3GHz / AMD A10-5800K APU (3.8GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GPU GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: "Judgment Day" contains intense psychological horror elements, disturbing imagery, and violent themes. The game includes scenes with blood, bodily injury, and corpses, as well as highly unsettling situations involving fear, distress, and mental anguish. Some sequences depict extremely violent or gory content, such as mutilation and detailed deaths. The game does not feature excessive or gratuitous violence but maintains a dark and immersive horror experience. Player discretion is advised, as certain scenes may be distressing to sensitive audiences. No depictions of sexual act.
